Machine Learning Engineer, New Grad

Description

Join a team that trains and ships models for search and recommendations at Example Corp. You will own a model end to end, from data collection and feature pipelines to offline evaluation and the online experiment that decides whether it ships.

New graduates start in a six-month rotation program with a dedicated mentor and a project reviewed by senior engineers.

What you will do

  • Build training and evaluation pipelines in Python and PyTorch.
  • Run A/B tests and read out their results.
  • Write the design documents for the models you own.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, statistics, or a related field, completed by June 2027.
  • Experience with Python and one deep learning framework.
  • Authorized to work in the United States.
